workflow.workingTitle: Moving from a Windows registry cleaner to Mac storage inspection
workflow.intent: Mac-replacement intent only: a former Windows user identifies whether the actual problem is storage growth or app activity rather than assuming registry repair is the same job.
workflow.distinctness: Task-triage checklist rather than an AVS feature matrix expanded into prose. No evidence of unique AVS-specific demand yet; prefer one general migration guide, not a product-name doorway.
outline: Establish operating system and actual symptom before selecting a tool.
Use official macOS storage guidance to distinguish storage categories and files worth inspecting; obtain Apple sources before writing procedural steps.
Inspect large locations without treating size as deletion permission; explain rebuild/download and backup costs.
Use app activity inspection for active CPU/memory concerns without claiming it proves ownership of writes.
Bounded disclosure: Breathing Room, which we build, is a macOS preview; it does not repair a Windows registry or diagnose a Windows VM.
workflow.interactionPass: Read-only decision checklist: Windows registry task -> keep Windows troubleshooting separate; Mac storage growth -> inventory/review; Mac app activity -> inspect processes. No cleanup action, fake results or forced code demo.
workflow.visualPlan: Current-source Space browser preview immediately after lead with required labels; a cleared and visually inspected official AVS UI later to explain the platform/task boundary. Current rights/access gate remains failed.
gates: Official Apple sources for any macOS procedural advice
